verdict.line: You win this by poking from Q range and dodging Shadow Dash; you lose it if you melee-trade into Feint and let his Q sustain stabilize him.

brief.thesis: Every one of Urgot's basic abilities outranges Shen's: Corrosive Charge (Q) hits at 800, Purge (W) at 490, Disdain (E) at 475, all beyond Shen's melee autos and 475-range Vorpal Blade (Q). Shen's only way to close that gap is Shadow Dash (E), a 575-range commitment on a 16-second cooldown at rank 1 that taunts but leaves him exposed if it misses. The data matches this shape exactly — Urgot holds lane advantage and solo-kill advantage, but the overall win rate still sits near even (50.2% over 871 games) because Feint (W) and Vorpal Blade's life tap let Shen survive the poke once he closes it.

theirWindow.when: Feint (W) and Vorpal Blade both up
theirWindow.what: His Feint shield absorbs a full burst and Vorpal Blade's life tap sustains him through the rest — don't force the all-in here. Throw a Q first to bait Feint out, or wait for it to be down before committing Purge (W).

yourWindow.what: He has no gap-close or escape — walk up and poke freely with Corrosive Charge (Q) at 800 range or chain autos and Purge (W) without fear of the taunt landing.

start.why: 87.3% pick rate at 51.5% win rate over 925 games — the AD and sustain win the early poke-range stat check before Shen's Q life tap comes online.

boots.why: 51.8% win rate over 490 games, 48% pick rate — Shen leans on frequent autos empowered by Ki Strike, and Plated Steelcaps cuts that incoming physical damage directly.

core.why: Armor shred lets your sustained autos and Purge chip through Feint's absorbed damage faster once the shield drops.
Bonus health and the tenacity passive keep you alive through the taunt window if Shadow Dash does land.
Best measured outcome of the listed core paths (56.2% win rate over 89 games) — the health and movement speed close distance after your poke lands.

situational.when: the enemy team adds magic damage sources beyond Shen
Shen's team is building around crit or attack speed carries
fights go long and you need sustained healing through extended trades

runes.keystoneWhy: Most-picked page for this matchup (26.8% pick, 51.2% win rate) — the bonus damage and shield on the third hit reward chaining autos into Purge once you've baited Feint out.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick (72.8% pick rate, 51.6% win rate) and converts your solo-kill advantage into real kills; Flash+Teleport (23.3% pick, 47.1% win rate) is the alternative if you need to prioritize scaling and tower pressure over early kill pressure.

playing.title: Dodge Shadow Dash with E
playing.detail: When Shen commits Shadow Dash (E, 575 range, taunts champions it hits), trigger Disdain (E) to move out of his path before it lands — Disdain's self-shield also eats the minor damage if you can't fully clear it.

playing.title: Poke freely when Dash is down
playing.detail: With Shadow Dash on cooldown (16/14/12/10/8s by rank), step up and throw Corrosive Charge (Q) or walk-poke with autos; he has no tool to close the gap or punish you for it.

playing.title: Rush W levels per skill order
playing.detail: The EWQWWRWEWEREEQQ order maxes Purge (W) early, dropping its cooldown toward 3s by mid-game — chain short trades on that near-zero downtime instead of one long stand-and-unload.

playing.title: Bait out Feint before all-in
playing.detail: Feint (W, 9/8/7/6/5s cooldown) absorbs a full trade's damage — throw a Q first to force it out, or wait for it to be down before committing Purge.

playing.title: Threaten the execute from level 6
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death (R, 100/85/70/70/70s cooldown) can execute Shen below its health threshold from 2500 range — once it's up, play for the solo kill the data says you're favored to get.

playing.title: Punish life tap by staying at range
playing.detail: Vorpal Blade (Q) only heals Shen when he lands it in melee — staying at Urgot's max range denies the sustain he'd otherwise get from trading into you.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and every win-rate and pick-rate figure here are pulled from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the cooldown numbers, range values, and tactical reasoning about dodging Shadow Dash and baiting Feint are my own read of the matchup, not measured stats.

stats.opponentTip: Use [E] when you are about to be hit with Shen’s (E). Contest lane from a distance to gain control over lane.
